2607.21196.title: Case study: solving P-99 with LPTP and an LLM
2607.21196.paper_summary: Ninety-Nine Prolog Problems (P-99) is a famous set of Prolog exercises. We solved the first thirty three just by prompting an LLM (Large Language Model). We used Claude from Anthropic. By solved we mean: generate the Prolog code and a test file, run the tests and check whether they pass, then formally prove types, groundness, termination, uniqueness, existence and also sometimes functional correctness with LPTP (Logic Program Theorem Prover). Hence our approach is an experiment in vibe-coding/vericoding of P-99. It is a vibe-coding experiment because we started from informal specifications written in English and let Claude generate the Prolog code. It also fits within vericoding because the LLM proved reliability guarantees on the generated Prolog code. Claude wrote 58 logic procedures, 508 tests, 257 lemmas for a total of 11800 proof lines. We manually checked each file generated by the LLM. We checked the Prolog code, ran the tests, examined the logical statements generated by Claude and proof-checked Claude's proofs with LPTP. This paper describes this experiment and provides the main details so that it can be reproduced by the interested reader.
2607.21196.paper_summary_zh: 九十九個 Prolog 問題 (P-99) 是一組著名的 Prolog 練習題。我們僅透過提示 LLM (大型語言模型) 解決了前三十三個問題。我們使用了 Anthropic 的 Claude。所謂的解決是指：生成 Prolog 代碼和測試文件，運行測試並檢查它們是否通過，然後正式證明類型、基礎性、終止性、唯一性、存在性，有時還有功能正確性，使用 LPTP (邏輯程序定理證明器)。因此，我們的方法是一種 P-99 的 vibe-coding/vericoding 實驗。這是一個 vibe-coding 實驗，因為我們從用英語寫的非正式規範開始，讓 Claude 生成 Prolog 代碼。這也符合 vericoding，因為 LLM 證明了生成的 Prolog 代碼的可靠性保證。Claude 寫了 58 個邏輯程序、508 個測試、257 個引理，共計 11800 行證明。我們手動檢查了 LLM 生成的每個文件。我們檢查了 Prolog 代碼，運行了測試，檢查了 Claude 生成的邏輯陳述，並用 LPTP 驗證了 Claude 的證明。本文描述了這個實驗並提供了主要細節，以便有興趣的讀者能夠重現。
